name: Hotel Angerhof
beschreibung: The Hotel Angerhof welcomes holidaymakers to a sunny, quiet setting in Serfaus on Tyrol's celebrated sunny plateau. Styled with alpine country warmth, the comfortable guest rooms feature contemporary en-suite bathrooms, satellite TV, Wi-Fi, and private balconies framing panoramic views across the Samnaun mountain range and soaring summits. After active hours exploring the alpine terrain, the on-site sauna facility with Finnish sauna and quiet relaxation lounge invites guests to rest. Each morning features a wholesome breakfast buffet laden with regional delicacies. Thanks to the peaceful location and immediate access to the unique Serfaus Dorfbahn underground railway, guests can reach the main cable car terminals effortlessly without a car. In summer, the Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis plateau is a dream destination for family hikes, nature theme parks, and mountain biking, while winter delivers premier skiing across vast terrain.
kurzbeschreibung: Cosy alpine hotel in Serfaus on Tyrol's sunny plateau with comfortable rooms, sauna area, and near the underground.
